OPSPROC_GAPS.text: Procedures scattered across the handbook, task tracker and document store — no single index existed. Closed: this register addresses it.
Incident management Steps 1–7 procedure not formally documented as a standalone doc.
No formal standalone "Privileged Access Management" procedure document (handbook + ticketing only).
Data deletion automation not in place — client data deletion relies on manual process (OFI-015).
Procedure versioning inconsistent — some docs have formal revision tables, others do not.
No formal review schedule enforced for individual procedure documents.
Standing compliance-review ticket for this register itself not yet filed.
Endpoint agent rollout still has 1 laptop pending — OFI-019 ~92% coverage.
